validation.details: Five enter/exit cycles; 10 camera handoffs; zero residual release connections; blocked-entry disable and lethal damage restore visibility/process/collision/controller/camera; observed 578.0738 px recovery over 60 ticks.

findings.title: Forced release can initially overlap blocked geometry
findings.evidence: pilotable_vehicle.gd:201-204,281-297,398-410; probe found fallback at (0,0) while blocked and clear point (480,0), with Godot recovery over 60 ticks.
findings.acceptance_impact: No persistent softlock reproduced; required pilot property and authority restoration passed. Keep safe-placement hardening for Field Scout lifecycle work.

findings.title: Destroy after disable suppresses vehicle_destroyed notification
findings.evidence: pilotable_vehicle.gd:188-211; enter→disable→destroy→destroy yielded release=1, disabled=1, destroyed=0; is_destroyed=true, health=0; no live signal consumers found.
findings.acceptance_impact: Archived acceptance and controller release behavior pass; no current consumer depends on a separate destroyed signal after prior disable.
